invariant.harness_neutral: It names no event, payload field, tool, env var or file path of one agent harness; what a harness provides is in `needs:`.
invariant.domain_truth: document-invariant: it states a domain truth, not an implementation mechanism.
invariant.violable: document-invariant: the system could get it wrong and it matters (not a restated schema).
invariant.always_true: document-invariant: an always-true condition, not a narrated runtime sequence.
invariant.observable: A promise a rule author or the person running the agent can observe and relies on, not a hidden mechanism.
invariant.mentions_complete: document-invariant: Everything it talks about that the entity catalog holds (an entity or a field, under any wording: a synonym, a paraphrase, a plain name) is written as that entry's typed mention. On a fail, quote the words and the token to use.
invariant.no_missing_field: document-invariant: Every concept it constrains or reads that is a value of the domain matches an entry of the catalog; a concept that matches none is a field the entity model is missing. On a fail, name the concept and the entity it belongs on.
invariant.concrete: document-invariant: its inputs are bounded, no word can be stretched, every list in it is closed.
invariant.decidable: document-invariant: it asks only for what a program can decide; where exactness would need running the domain's rules without limit, it states where exactness stops and what is reported there.
invariant.terms_defined_once: document-invariant: a term several invariants rely on is defined once (an entity, a field's doc or enum, an invariant) and cited, not re-worded here.
invariant.one_owner: document-invariant: an effect it decides on a tracked value is decided by it alone; one another invariant owns is cited, not restated.
invariant.entity_rules: document-entity, as it bears on an invariant: each field it mentions is used as its doc defines it; a bound, format or enum on one field's own value is on the field (constraint_expr or enum), not here; a reference to another entity goes through a field's type; it does not contradict or redefine a cited entity's or field's doc; an absent or unknown value follows that field's closed rule.

entity.domain_facts: document-entity: every field carries a domain fact, not a storage artifact.
entity.constraints_on_field: document-entity: a value constraint is in constraint_expr or enum, not prose.
entity.enum_shape: document-entity: an enum field is a string type plus an enum array.
entity.reference_by_type: document-entity: a reference to another entity is the field's type.
entity.docs_define: document-entity: docs define the construct, never state a rule.
entity.domain_concept: document-entity: a domain concept, not a wire format.
entity.once_per_domain: document-entity: it exists once per domain.
entity.closed_absence: document-entity: a field that may be absent says exactly when, by a closed rule; a per-item field keeps its meaning when one source item yields several.
